title: AI Interpretation for TB, HIV, and Hepatitis Care
summary: Use AI interpretation for TB, HIV, and hepatitis care while protecting privacy, explaining test results, and verifying treatment plans.
body_markdown:
###


Confirm the patient's spoken and written language, dialect when relevant, safe contact channel, who is present, and whether diagnosis-specific wording may appear in messages. Identify the visit purpose without exposing sensitive information in shared spaces.


###


Name the test and distinguish risk, inactive TB infection, active TB disease, treatment, and infection-control instructions. Use the clinician's terminology consistently and identify the next action.


###


Name the test, state the result and unit as the clinician presents them, explain viral suppression or undetectable status in the specific context, and verify the medication and follow-up plan with teach-back.


###


Keep hepatitis B and hepatitis C pathways separate. Identify the virus, exact test, current clinical interpretation, treatment or monitoring plan, and the laboratory step needed to assess response.


###


Yes, with privacy controls, clear audio, disease-specific terminology, verification of numbers and negation, teach-back, documentation, and a fallback based on patient preference, policy, and encounter needs.
